@@ -1799,3 +1794,21 @@
-# At time of writing, it is not yet known to what extent Manitoba's 2026-09-17
-# announcement may spur further adaptations in northwestern Ontario; see
-# Manitoba, below.
+#
+# From Tim Parenti (2026-10-13):
+# On 2026-09-17, after neighboring Manitoba announced a shift to year-round -05
+# (see Manitoba, below), local leaders throughout northwestern Ontario
+# coordinated regionally alongside their local members of provincial parliament
+# to swiftly conduct several local surveys on the matter ahead of a potential
+# divergence on 2026-11-01.  All of the surveys returned more than 90% support
+# for remaining in alignment with the “Manitoba model”.
+# https://www.nwonewswatch.com/local-journalism-initiative-lji/vast-majority-want-to-end-time-changes-mayor-12838025
+# https://www.kenoraminerandnews.com/news/local-news/kenora-asks-province-to-end-clock-changes/article_5118b819-9f67-42ce-938a-1478b8ab541e.html
+# From Aoun Khan and Chris Walton (2026-10-13):
+# Ontario is set to move parts of the province’s northwest region to permanent
+# daylight time in order to align with Manitoba.
+# https://www.cp24.com/news/canada/2026/10/13/ontario-to-move-northwest-regions-to-permanent-daylight-time/
+# The provincial government has issued a written news release:
+# https://news.ontario.ca/en/release/1008130/ontario-moving-to-permanent-daylight-saving-time-in-parts-of-northwestern-ontario
+# From Heitor David Pinto (2026-10-22):
+# [On 2026-10-19] the government of Ontario issued [Regulation 333/26] setting
+# the time in the part of the province west of 90°W as UTC-5 all year.  It
+# comes into force on 1 November 2026.
+# https://www.ontario.ca/laws/regulation/r26333
@@ -1979,7 +1992,7 @@
-# The new Act comes into force by order of the Lieutenant Governor in Council.
-# From Tim Parenti (2026-09-21):
-# With Manitoba now adopting year-round -05, the area around Creighton will
-# likely wish to follow.  As the area doesn't have a special charter like
-# Lloydminster, the existing de facto arrangement technically violates
-# provincial law already, but once the new Act takes effect it will better
-# allow for continued alignment with Manitoba, per the above.
+# From Tim Parenti (2026-10-27), per Heitor David Pinto (2026-10-27):
+# Order in Council 438/2026 brings the new Act into force from 2026-10-30.
+# https://publications.saskatchewan.ca/#/products/130175
+# This should allow the area around Creighton to more straightforwardly remain
+# aligned with Manitoba on year-round -05, since its previous de facto
+# arrangement technically violated provincial law without a special charter
+# like Lloydminster.

+# From Tim Parenti (2026-10-15):

@@ -3560,0 +3574,11 @@

+# On October 24, 2026, the Cuban authorities announced that daylight saving

+# during the period in which standard time would normally be in effect "to
+# avoid disrupting social activities during the early part of the day".

@@ -804,0 +804,10 @@
+# From Daniel Dias Rodrigues (2026-10-20):
+# Under Brazilian law, a period stated as "until day X" includes day X.
+# From Tim Parenti (2026-10-27):
+# With the decrees explicitly naming the hour of 01:00 for only a few fall back
+# transitions, there remains some ambiguity in whether other implied midnight
+# fall back transitions may have therefore been intended as 24:00s (i.e.,
+# 25:00 -> 24:00) rather than as 24:00 (24:00 -> 23:00), particularly prior to
+# 1966.  Since contemporaneous reporting was somewhat inconsistent on this,
+# minimize changes from earlier tzdb versions where there is ambiguity.
+
@@ -808,1 +818,1 @@
